verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents an official remote MCP server. Any MCP client or agent can be pointed at it to call 3,000+ APIs and 10,000+ tools, and the server handles user auth, and the probe confirms it in the official docs and llms.txt. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, and detailed connection specifics (endpoint, transport, client setup steps) in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Add Pipedream MCP to your app or agent to make tool calls on behalf of your users to 3,000+ APIs and 10,000+ tools.
Point any MCP client at Pipedream's remote server ... Your agent picks the tool — auth is already handled
This is handled automatically by Pipedream's MCP server and there's no additional implementation required
